source_notes: One CQD synthesis route on p2; Scheme 1 lower row and Figures 2/3B downstream Pro/Try specimens are separate.
Figure 3A TEM mean 2.31 nm and Figure 4B DLS 2.3 nm are distinct methods on pristine CQDs, not an asserted same aliquot.
Figure 3A 0.20 nm fringe is indexed by authors to graphite carbon (100), without establishing a unique bulk phase.
FTIR 3386 and 3270 cm−1 peaks are explicitly approximate in source prose.
Figure 4B ~600 nm CQDs/Pro distribution is an assay aggregate comparator, not pristine product size.
evidence_conflicts: Main Experimental calls the centrifuged material a white precipitate but does not explain its redispersion before dialysis.
Figure 3A pristine CQDs and Figure 3B CQDs/Pro aggregates are distinct specimens; aggregate size does not label the synthesis product.
